args.content:
## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimwear
- Quick-dry shorts and t-shirts
- Light long sleeves for shade
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Beach sandals
- Hiking boots (for volcano hikes)
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Sunhat or wide-brimmed hat
- Sunglasses

### Essentials
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Reusable water bottle
- Travel-sized toiletries
- Travel adapter
- Small first-aid kit
- Passport/ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Cash and cards

### Toiletries
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Towel
- Razors and shaving cream
- Feminine hygiene products (if applicable)

### Entertainment
- Books or e-reader
- Travel journal/notebook
- Writing utensils
- Portable speaker
- Headphones

### Miscellaneous
- Snorkel and mask
- Beach towel
- Umbrella
- Camera
- Travel pillow and blanket
- Snacks and energy bars
- Travel-sized laundry detergent
